create_function_track_file: track a file for cleanup by path and category in the disk-cleanup system
run_function_quick_cleanup: run deterministic cleanup of tracked test, temp, and cron-output files and remove empty directories
run_function_deep_cleanup: run interactive deep cleanup with confirm callable for research, chrome-profile, and large files
test_function_dry_run: test which tracked files would be auto-deleted and which need user prompt without touching any files
summarize_function_status: summarize tracked files by category and list the top 10 largest tracked files
